title: Pearcedale Community Market
summary: Monthly community market at Pearcedale Community Centre, held on the 3rd Saturday of every month. Fresh locally baked bread, honey, jam, craft stalls, potted plants, food and coffee. Under shading eucalypts. Dog-friendly (on lead).
